Should I choose AI visuals or CGI?

Choose around the detail that must remain accurate. Generated visuals can support mood and scene exploration; controlled CGI can support precise geometry and repeatable product views. A hybrid approach may combine approved product assets with generated surroundings.

What product assets should I provide?

Share accurate photographs, available 3D models, packaging artwork and approved product information. Identify which dimensions, colours, labels and movements must remain correct. Review the complete moving shot, not only its opening frame.
